# FRONTA
> Websites and apps, built right.

FRONTA is a Croatian design and development studio creating websites, web applications, and digital products for companies and product teams.

## Practices
- Marketing sites & landing pages
- Product UI, dashboards & internal tools

## Standard
- Tested thoroughly
- Opinionated
- Performance-aware
- Built for the handoff
